notes.title: Catching Up on the Last Two Updates!
notes.content:
Bowling Enhancements🏃‍♂️
Bowling strategies now adapt dynamically to user gameplay, with more varied line and length combinations.

Revised bowling regions for left-handed batsmen.

Unlimited Overs Mode: Bowling spells and special deliveries have been updated.

Bowlers now switch to around the wicket if too many runs are conceded from over the wicket.

Automatic Ball Trace added for Medium and Hard bowling levels.

Improved wide ball detection for higher accuracy.

Spinner lengths corrected in Practice Mode.

Updated ball physics ensures more realistic bowling speeds — both in air and off the pitch.

Dry and Normal pitch options introduced in higher difficulty modes.

Fielding Enhancements🤾‍♂️ 
Field placement now dynamically adjusts based on batsman's hitting regions and remains consistent throughout the match.

Improved fielding for edges, misfields, and increased catching chances for wicketkeeper and slips.

Updated ball deflection logic after misfields.

Physics Enhancements🏏  
Ball movement on edges feels more natural and responsive.

Enhanced friction dynamics between the ball and grass for improved realism.

Increased ball bounce after pitching across all pitch types.

Reduced ball velocity upon pitching, with variation depending on the pitch type.

Gameplay Improvements🎮 
Stadium radius is now shown in both QuickStart and Shop.

Target-setting logic revamped in Team Chasing Challenge for better difficulty balance.

Field positions within fieldsets now adjust more accurately to the batsman's scoring patterns.

Battery Optimization: Play full 50-over matches without recharging the headset.

Updated Meta SDK for improved performance and security.

New Assets🏟️👕 
Two new stadiums added and available in the Shop.

Team jerseys updated with upgraded city-based designs.

notes.title: iB Cricket Key Updates 2024!!
notes.content:
Updates Summary:
We have enhanced various systems, including fielding, bowling, field settings, pitch parameters, and commentary. We've upgraded the graphics quality, providing a more immersive experience. Significant updates have been made to the look and feel of the game with new stadiums, a new dressing room, new bat skins, new jerseys, and revamped the home screen UX for a more intuitive navigation experience. We've also added detailed live match stats in the game to help you analyze and refine your gameplay.

We've completely revamped the onboarding experience for new users and added an FAQ section that contains insights and solutions for a smooth, enjoyable gaming experience.

For more details on all the enhancements, updates and changes, please refer to the detailed notes.

Detailed Notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37457279/5d8663204d1d801202c9d1d79c7c122e6d5247bd.png
Bowling🤾‍♂️

 We’ve enhanced the bowling logic to bring it closer to real-world cricket
 Bowlers maintain consistent strength in Insane and Ultra-insane modes
 Significantly enhanced the effectiveness of swing, seam, cutters, and spin deliveries.
 Refined the speed and angle of spin for spin bowlers and fine-tuned the speed for cutters.
 Dynamic variations in bowling with enhanced line and length adjustments that adapt to field settings, batsmen's scoring areas etc providing a more strategic gameplay
 Improved the distribution algorithm of right-arm and left-arm bowlers selected and actively bowling throughout matches
 Improved Intelligent field placements based on the batsmen’s scoring regions throughout the match
 Improved AI strategies for maintaining fair gameplay
 The issue of consecutive wides has been resolved

Fielding🏃

 Fielding has been made more realistic
 Enhanced fielder selection logic to ensure more relevant fielders are chosen, based on the ball's hit direction and speed
 Improved fielding accuracy and game realism
 Significant improvement has been made in how fielders collect the ball
 Fielders will position themselves more accurately to collect the ball in line with its trajectory
 Fine-tuned running speeds for fielders, ensuring they reach the ball with optimal timing
 Bowlers now have improved reaction times when balls are hit towards them
 Fielders now immediately react when the ball hits the helmet in helmet view, preventing unnecessary byes

Pitches:

 Enhanced the realism in the behavior of swing, seam, cutters, spin, and bounciness across Green, Bouncy, Dry, and Normal pitches
 Swing, seam, cutters, and spin now vary based on ball newness in Insane and Ultra-Insane modes, adding depth to gameplay strategy
 Bounce on dry pitches is updated to match real-world conditions

Commentary🎙️

 Improved the commentary with additional phrases to enhance your game experience.
 Voice quality for commentary has been upgraded
 Made corrections to contextual inaccuracies in certain commentary phrases

Home Screen UX/UI:

 We've revamped the home screen UX and UI for more intuitive navigation by categorizing the game modes.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37457279/331def8c1faa3d1fe9c97a7c0ed4bd11deffef58.png
New Stadiums🏟️

 Five new world-class stadiums and one practice stadium are now available for purchase in the shop

Dressing Room

 New Dressing Room with a fresh look and feel

New Bat Skins:

 New Bat skins with enhanced wood textures for a more authentic cricketing experience

New Stumps:

 We've introduced illuminated stumps that light up dynamically whenever the ball makes contact with them enhancing immersion and making every wicket feel even more impactful

Updated Jerseys👕

 Updated jersey designs, offering a fresh look for both International and Indian city teams

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37457279/ab72d289bf876c3c3ad0dbd6aee6f7d47f5d41d5.png
In-Game VR Match Stats🏏

 Added the following live detailed match stats at the end of each delivery to help you analyze and refine your gameplay.
 Ball Trace of Deliveries: Track the ball deliveries for each over.
 Pitch Map of Deliveries: Access the pitch map for the complete innings so far, as well as for the current over.
 3D Wagon Wheel (Beta): Visualize the last 30 balls faced with our new 3D wagon wheel feature.
 Worm Graph & Manhattan Graph: Analyze your innings with the comprehensive Worm graph and Manhattan graph.
 Match Summary: Get a complete summary of the match, including detailed scorecard of batsmen and bowlers

My Matches:

 Access the pending matches of the following match types from your VR game in a single place
 Knockout matches from Season Tournament
 Dual-player leagues with 10-over and 50-over matches

In-Game FAQs🤔

 You can now access FAQs directly in the VR game for instant help. Get answers and support without leaving the game!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37457279/b6288b46396b0a702464dd1d3e04be77dfd91a6e.png
New User Flow:

 We have revamped the onboarding process, aimed at ensuring a smoother and quicker learning curve for the new users. The updated steps dynamically adapt to the user's gameplay making the introduction more intuitive and seamless.

Custom Tournaments:

 Organizers can now configure the end date of tournaments to better suit their scheduling needs.
 Introducing Ultra-Insane bowling difficulty option for those seeking the ultimate challenge.
 Invitation message now includes comprehensive match configuration details, ensuring all participants are fully informed.
 Addressed the net run-rate calculation issue
 Corrected the logic of fixture creation for knockout matches

Team Chasing Challenge🎯

 Our targeting system now intelligently adapts based on your progress, ensuring a more personalized gameplay experience.

Season Tournaments:

 View schedules for 250, 500, and 1000 tournaments directly from the tournaments home screen, ensuring you never miss a match.

notes.title: Exciting updates in Leagues, Bowler profiles, Fielding algorithm and more.
notes.content:
Hello players, new update is available with following features.

Major Features

Leagues

Create bowling presets within the Leagues, which are to be picked at random & played by users from all across the world. You can create a bowling preset for each of the pitch types - Green, Bouncy and Dry. For green pitch a maximum of 1 spinner is allowed & for dry pitch maximum of 3 spinners are allowed. Also, you can name the bowlers the way you want!
Apart from the single 10 over match you get to play in the beginner/expert leagues everyday, now you can play more matches in the bowling presets set by other players, who are picked at random. You will be awarded fanbase and gems.
Also, in addition to the everyday 10 over match in the leagues, we’re adding a 50 over match. And for every four days, a new 50 over match will be added. No toss for 50 over in this release.
You can opt out of any category (10 over, 50 over, bowling presets) of the league matches individually and also you can switch leagues.


Bowling Profiles

4 Bowling profiles with field changes in unlimited overs. Bowling lines more consistent on or around off stump.
Swing bowlers with strong in or out swing with occasional balls going the other way. This profile can be picked when the ball is new and also when the ball gets old 60 to 80.
Cutters bowlers with strong off or leg cutter with occasional ball going the other way. This profile can be picked anytime over a period of 80 overs for a given ball. Frequency of cutters change based on the age of the ball.
Bouncers and Yorkers. This profile occasionally gets selected when a batsman scores over 40 runs and 16 overs have passed in the innings.
Spin bowlers will be selected more often based on pitch and aggressive fieldsets will be placed. Spin bowlers also bowl consistently around good length.


Fielding Algorithm changes

In case of ground shots, when the fielder reaches to the ball and does not have the time to bend & pick up the ball fielder will miss the ball based on fielder
Dive catches and dive fielding probability of fielder catching/ fielding bat is reduced to 22 - 30% based on fielder
Fielders wont catch balls when running backwards if the ball angle is flat.
Keepers reaction times have been corrected and keeper wont concede byes.

 
Enhancements

Leg side wides region is corrected considering shoulder width of a batsman.
At the end of the game, players will get to the bat scores of each bat and in case of a PvP match, players will get to see each others individual bat scores as well
Ball speed is shown both in MPH and KMPH by default.
Bat grip region is restricted to promote fair play.
Practice stadium is now available in PVP matches as well.
Now the option to look at the umpire to start the next ball is available in the practise module as well.
From this update, whenever there is any change in the fieldset, batsmen will be notified.
Fielder behind bowler runup is restricted!
Improvised keeper reaction to reduce byes and also stop catching some unexpected catches.
Within a PvP match, one player will get to know the other player, who is going to join the hosted game.
Now users can also play an unlimited overs match in PVP (Beta)
Bat stats displayed when a new bat comes into play.
Current partnership is shown while batting.
Extras have a place on in ground score card in quick start matches
Bowlers summary stats displayed.
End of innings summary stats displayed.
Different colors for ball trails have been implemented based on bat hit region.
PVP has play again option with same configuration
Host stadiums will be available to play in PVP
Field Set will be sorted in alphabetical order in PVP
Quick Start will retain the config of previously played matches.
Practice stadium available in Quick start(New)
Join room needs approval from host.(New)


Join us on Discord - https://discord.gg/JCbDw82

notes.title: iB Cricket Early Access V2.0.0 is now available
notes.content:
Hello Players,
Some of the most awaited updates such as PvP, Leagues are now available in Early Access. A big round of applause to the Early Access community for their valuable feedback on PvP feature during Beta.

New Features
Expert League: Players will be competing against those who are of the same level & will be rewarded upon winning the match. Initially every user will be starting with a Fanbase of 15000 & compete against each other. Upon completion of the match, a certain amount of the "Fanbase" will be deducted from the loser and added to the "Fanbase" of the winner.

Match Frequency: 1 match/day
Match Configuration: 10 overs with 3 wickets, Bat Shield: OFF, Bowling Level: Medium to start increases as you win
Match-making: Two players having almost the same Fanbase will be matched together. As we progress, changes will be made to the match-making process.
 Beginners League: This is similar to "Expert League" with a few changes such as the player will be starting with a "Fanbase" of 1500 instead of 15000. And, the match will be played with Bat Shield: 50%, Bowling Level: Easy. 

PvP is now available in Early Access. Below are the latest additions to the PvP, to what you've experienced previously in the beta branch.

Now you can configure the match, bowl & toss within HMD. 
With voice chat integration, now you can talk to your opponent while playing the game. 
Now you can exit the match & continue later.
We've made a few changes in the flow for a smoother experience and also reduced the waiting time.
List of created rooms are displayed within the game.
Easy to remember ROOM IDs have been configured.

Enhancements

Buttons to choose the "Next Bat" will be closer to the batsman.
Normalized the number of full tosses bowled by the spin bowlers.
Fieldset screen placements in stadiums have been corrected.
Within settings you can adjust the duration of “Looking at the umpire” to start the next ball.
"Next over" button is available at the end of the over and you can start the first ball of the over by looking at the bowler profile.
Now within the companion app you can see the direction of every single shot that you’ve scored. Also, you can check out the same of your opponents in the League, PvP matches.

notes.title: iB Cricket Early Access v1.0.14 Released
notes.content:
Hello Players, 
Thanks for your feedback!! In this update, we fixed the following bugs & made enhancements as per the feedback.

Enhancements
1. To bring in a more real-world experience, we've ensured that the bat doesn't go into the ground while playing.
2. Bat size when playing with/without shield is now the same as a real-world professional cricket bat.
3. Now exit button is available within the dressing room to quit the game.
4. You'll get to see the score of each bat at the end of the match.
5. You can check-out the status of tournaments even if you haven't subscribed to them on profile.ib.cricket

Note: As the size of the bat (with/without bat shield) has been reduced to match with the real-world professional cricket bat, we're resetting the high scores of everyone. 

Bug Fixes
1. Ball traveling too far when hit to handle of the bat is resolved.
2. Now, your highest score with a single bat will be displayed accurately at profile.ib.cricket.
3. Disabled the legacy mixed-reality support.

Enhancements in the Beta branch
1. Now both the players in PvP can choose a Jersey of their choice & compete against each other.

Bug Fixes in the Beta branch
1. We've resolved the issue which is causing a mismatch between fielding and scoring.

notes.title: Public Beta for one of the most awaited features, 'Local PvP' is now available
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37457279/11ccd843c65cc298d7dfbbd305f4ce251661e024.jpg

In this beta-version, you get to bowl to your friends & challenge him in one-on-one match. As it is a "Local PvP", you and your friend need to play on the same system (PC / Laptop). One player bowls from the controls given on the monitor and the other bats in VR.

To start Local PvP in beta branch, all you need to do is, go to the dressing room and press F7 in the keyboard. To close the Local PvP screen in the dressing room, press F8 in the keyboard.


Local PvP
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37457279/5023f39b68429a560470d4409413f9f79713a5f1.png

Enter your names, select the size of the bat-shield, stadium, environment, and overs of your choice, and start the match.


Choose the Bowling Style
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37457279/389110d87099b51ad1cbe73e0b7455a66fa321d9.png

You can select from any of the given bowlers. You will be given 15 seconds to choose a bowler.


Strategize the Bowling & Fielding
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37457279/502ebff17405b7cde0f6064ab2232d6c1a9bfd86.png

To make it more exciting, we have introduced the concept of Efforts(e) in bowling. For the line & length you select to bowl, you need to spend some efforts. If you wanted to bowl a special-ball, you need to spend some efforts. These efforts will reset at the start of each over. So with the available efforts, you need to choose wisely, strategize, and bowl. Also, you can choose from the predefined fieldsets to strategize the fielding.

You will be given 15 seconds for each delivery to choose from the different options available and bowl.

We will be glad to hear your feedback and suggestions. Based on the feedback and suggestions received, we will release the "Online PvP" soon. 

Check-out how to switch to Beta Branch on Steam: https://discordapp.com/channels/762605669332287508/788994124862193694/789091491087122452
